MR. FUJI: So, [VAR TRNAME(0000)]...\c
Your Pokédex quest is one that requires
strong dedication.\c
Without deep love for Pokémon, it will be hard
to complete such a task.\c
I’m not sure if this will help you, but I’d like you
to have it.
You got the [VAR COLOR(0006)]Poké Flute[VAR COLOR(0000)] from Mr. Fuji!
Upon hearing the Poké Flute, sleeping Pokémon\nwill spring awake.\c\nTry using it if you ever find a sleeping Pokémon.
MR. FUJI: Has my Poké Flute helped you?
